memories.content: Qualified lead threshold: company size above 200 employees and a named budget owner.
Never contact leads in the healthcare sector without legal review of the outreach text.
Preferred meeting slots for discovery calls are Tuesday and Thursday between 10:00 and 12:00 Jakarta time.
Pricing floor: Business tier is never discounted more than 15 percent without approval from the account executive.
Clients in Indonesia prefer proposals written in Bahasa Indonesia with figures in rupiah.
Escalate any lead that mentions a competitor contract renewal within 90 days to the head of sales.
Lead scoring: +20 for a job title of director or above, +10 for a visited pricing page, -30 for a free email domain.
Tenant timezone is Asia/Jakarta (UTC+7); daily reports go out at 08:00 local time.
Do not send follow-up emails on Indonesian public holidays or on weekends.
The CRM of record is Odoo; every qualified lead must have an Odoo opportunity before handover.
Call with PT Nusantara Logistik: interested in the workflow automation package, budget approved for Q4.
Sent proposal v2 to Bayu Santoso at Sinar Retail; awaiting reply on the rollout timeline.
Lead from webinar: Maria Wijaya, finance director at Kopi Kita, asked about invoice automation.
Kopi Kita requested a demo on Friday; the demo environment must include the invoice reconciliation flow.
Bounce rate on the September outreach batch was 4.2 percent, mostly from stale addresses.
PT Nusantara Logistik legal asked for a data processing addendum before signing.
Sinar Retail is comparing us with a competitor called RetailFlow; decision expected end of month.
Discovery call with Adi Prasetyo (CTO, Mitra Digital): concerned about data residency in Indonesia.
Mitra Digital wants an on-premise option; told them cloud only for now, will revisit in Q1.
Webinar on 3 September produced 41 registrants, 12 qualified as leads.
Follow-up sequence for cold leads changed from five touches to three touches.
Hotel Permata Group asked for a multi-branch pricing quote covering eight properties.
Hotel Permata Group chose the Business tier; contract signed on 14 August.
Onboarding call with Hotel Permata is scheduled; their admin contact is Ratna Kusuma.
Trade show in Surabaya generated 25 business cards; only 3 met the qualification threshold.
Rapat dengan Toko Maju Jaya: mereka tertarik paket otomasi laporan penjualan mingguan.
Pak Hendra dari Toko Maju Jaya minta diskon 20 persen, sudah kami tolak sesuai batas 15 persen.
Klien Bank Daerah Kalimantan meminta dokumen keamanan dan bukti sertifikasi sebelum demo.
Prospek dari LinkedIn: Sari Dewi, kepala operasional CV Berkah Tekstil, tanya integrasi dengan Odoo.
CV Berkah Tekstil butuh pelatihan untuk 15 karyawan sebelum go-live.
Renewal risk: Warung Digital contract ends in October, usage dropped 40 percent last month.
Support ticket from Kopi Kita: the invoice PDF export shows the wrong currency symbol.
Weekly pipeline review: 9 open opportunities, total forecast value 1.2 billion rupiah.
Quarterly target for new logos is 12; we closed 7 by the end of the previous quarter.
Board meeting is held on the first Monday of every month at 09:00.
Investor update draft is due Friday; include pipeline and churn numbers.
Travel booking for the Surabaya trade show was handled by the office manager.
Never contact leads in the healthcare sector without legal review of the outreach text.
Call with PT Nusantara Logistik about warehouse robotics.
Pricing floor: Business tier is never discounted more than 30 percent.
